description: Open a support ticket in your user's AlterLab account when they need a human: a billing, account or data problem. Do not use it for scrape friction, blocks or ideas; use `alterlab_feedback` for those. Ask the user first: a ticket reaches a human and emails them. Requires an API key. Describe the problem in `body`; do not include secrets, API keys, passwords or customer data. The user gets the usual confirmation email and the ticket appears in their dashboard. Limited to 3 open tickets and 5 per day per key; when over the limit the error points to the open ticket. Returns ticket_id, ticket_ref and status. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

body.description: What the user needs help with

on_behalf_of_user.description: True when the user asked you to file this. Default: true

tool_name.description: Tool or endpoint the ticket is about

name: alterlab_support_ticket
title: Open Support Ticket
